steps.en: Install the skill and supply topic, format, duration and style
steps.zh: 安装技能并提供主题、画幅、时长和风格

steps.en: Draft a director's proposal with scenes and narration
steps.zh: 起草含场景和旁白的导演方案

steps.en: Revise and explicitly approve the current proposal
steps.zh: 修改并明确批准当前方案

steps.en: Emit self-contained clip prompts and continuity notes
steps.zh: 输出独立片段提示词与连续性说明

steps.en: Generate clips externally and assemble the video
steps.zh: 到外部服务生成片段并剪辑成片

value.en: A reviewed story becomes a consistent prompt package for generation
value.zh: 经确认的故事变成连续一致的生成提示词包
